observedBehaviour: A row cell refuses a nested row, but three other horizontal arrangements survive there. A table builds inside a row cell and its own box spans the full cell width, which is as much as this probe can see: a table's cell children are not named snapshot entities, so whether the cell CONTENT draws is a separate question this arm does not answer (see table-cell-loses-composite-content). A shape container placing two children with LayerAlign anchors lays them out side by side. An inline shape run measures into a paragraph line inside a row cell. Flattening the pair into the OUTER row's own columns also works and needs no container at all. So a two-column page is not restricted to vertical stacks in its columns: tabular content stays a table, and an icon-beside-text pair is either an inline run or a shape container with anchors. This is a menu of ARRANGEMENTS that survive a row cell, not a claim that everything placed in one draws.

minimalReproduction.arrangement: Four arrangements, one document each: a two-column table in a row cell (measured by its own box against the cell, because a table's cell children are not named snapshot entities); a shape container positioning two paragraphs CENTER_LEFT at different x; the same pair carried as columns of the outer row; and a paragraph whose first run is an inline dot.

workaround: Not a defect to work around — a menu. Prefer the cheapest arrangement that carries the meaning: an inline run for an icon beside a label, a table for genuinely tabular rows, a shape container with anchors for a fixed-size pair, and outer-row columns when the pair can simply be flattened.

sourceRun.note: Written before the first render, because row-cannot-nest-in-row-cell rules out the obvious structure for a two-column proposal page and the alternatives had to be settled before the architecture was chosen. Imported into this tree on 2026-08-28 and re-measured here against released 2.2.2 and 2.2.1; the version on the record was corrected from 2.2.0, which the source tree could not have measured (its probe.mjs has no --build and its diagnostics pom pins 2.2.1).
